run.question: List the top 5 largest Elasticsearch indices matching the pattern 'app-184-*' by document count. Show their names and doc counts.

report.summary: Querying Elasticsearch for indices matching 'app-184-*' returned 1800 indices (list not truncated for the index,docs.count query). Exactly five of them hold 500 documents each; the other 1795 hold 1 document each. Therefore the top 5 by document count are app-184-data-analytics-2024.01.10, app-184-engineering-api-2024.01.20, app-184-ml-worker-2024.01.25, app-184-platform-billing-2024.01.15 and app-184-security-auth-2024.01.05, all tied at 500 documents. Those five are the largest; there is no sixth index above 1 document. The doc counts and store sizes are a point-in-time reading of the cluster at about 2026-11-23T19:26:12Z; the index listing carries no time filter, so these counts are not proven for any other moment, including inside the authorized historical window.
